## Change

Describe the portal change or independent library documentation promotion.

## Checks

- [ ] Strict MkDocs build passes; preview links and assets verified.
- [ ] Preview root, library/version navigation and assets verified.

## Release promotion (if applicable)

- Library / version / software tag / full commit SHA:
- Maven Central publication evidence:
- Clean external consumer verification evidence:
- [ ] Tagged public guides have matching version/dependency/Javadoc references.
- [ ] Existing workflow pins retained; landing page links to the newest approval.
- [ ] No historical Core imports, unpublished Spring claims or moving-main content.
- [ ] Other library can remain unavailable; no domain transfer implied by promotion.
